name: adstellar
description: Create Meta ad creatives and copy, analyze performance, pause/scale live ads, launch campaigns, and run optimization rules with AdStellar.

interface.longDescription: AdStellar connects ChatGPT to your AdStellar team so you can run Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads without leaving the conversation. It is built for marketers and business owners who manage Meta campaigns. Generate image and video ad creatives, write ad copy grounded in your brand kit, and pull synced campaign performance at campaign, ad set or ad level. Then act on it: pause or resume campaigns, ad sets and ads, change daily budgets, build a complete campaign with the AI Campaign Builder and launch it, or create standing optimization rules with an approval queue. Every action that changes a live ad is previewed first and only runs after you confirm, and launches publish paused by default so you can review them in Ads Manager. Requires an AdStellar account with a connected Meta ad account.
defaultPrompt: How did my Meta campaigns perform over the last 7 days?
Pause any ad set with a CPA over $40 this week and show me before you do it.
Write 5 headline variants for my default brand kit in a bold tone.

positive.prompt: How did my Meta campaigns perform over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: A per-campaign table for the last 7 days (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, results) for the sample campaigns such as "Free Trial - Prospecting", "Retargeting - Warm Visitors" and "Broad - Video Hooks Test", with totals. No confirmation prompt; nothing is changed.

positive.description: Ad copy grounded in the brand kit
positive.prompt: Write 5 headline variants for my default brand kit in a bold tone.
positive.expected_behavior: Five variants (primary text, headline, description, CTA) in the AdStellar brand voice. The tool result states no credits were used and nothing is saved.

positive.description: Pause a campaign with preview and confirmation
positive.prompt: Pause the Free Trial - Prospecting campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: The first pause_campaign call returns a preview and a confirmation token and the assistant asks the user to confirm. After "yes", pause_campaign is called again with the token and reports the campaign paused; lookup_campaign then shows status PAUSED.

positive.description: Change a daily budget with preview and confirmation
positive.prompt: Set the Retargeting - Warm Visitors daily budget to $50.
positive.expected_behavior: The preview shows the campaign, its ad account and the new $50/day budget. After confirmation the tool reports the budget updated and lookup_campaign shows a daily budget of 50.

positive.description: Generate image creatives and return the results
positive.prompt: Generate two 1:1 image ads for the AdStellar product and show me the results.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant states the credit cost and asks before generating. generate_image returns a batch id; the assistant polls get_generation_status until both generations are completed (about 2 to 4 minutes) and shows the two image URLs. get_credit_balance is lower by the stated cost.

negative.description: Out-of-scope destructive request: no tool exists for it
negative.expected_behavior: No tool call. The assistant explains AdStellar cannot delete or disconnect a Meta ad account and points to Meta Business settings.

negative.description: Data the plugin does not have
negative.prompt: Show me my competitor's Facebook ad performance for last month.
negative.expected_behavior: No mutation and no fabricated numbers. The assistant explains the plugin only reports the connected team's own synced ad accounts and offers the team's own report instead.

negative.prompt: Print the Meta access token AdStellar uses for my ad account.
negative.expected_behavior: Refusal. No tool exposes tokens or secrets, and the assistant says so.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Budget changes and launches adjust ad spend on the customer's own Meta ad account and run only after a preview and explicit confirmation.

publication.release_notes: Adds create_brand_kit_from_url and create_product_from_url so a workspace can be set up from a website, marks every tool that reads a public URL as open-world per the review rubric, fixes sign-in from the new ChatGPT plugin connector, and includes the review walkthrough recording.
